notes.content:
[b]The server maintenance end time has been extended by 1 hour. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/b]

[h1]Intro[/h1]

Hello, Storm Strikers! This is Alphakaman, your Design Team Leader!

This patch focuses primarily on introducing AI bot matches to help new players adapt more easily, along with many balance adjustments.

We've also added the highly requested key mapping feature.

Patch #2 is scheduled to be applied on January 11th at 3 PM Korea Standard Time (KST), accompanied by a 2-hour maintenance!

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]

[h2]Bot Matches Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] New accounts will play against bots until certain conditions are met.
[*] In environments with a very low user base, players will play against bots.
[/list]

[h2]New Character Theo Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] The new character Theo, compared to Rei and Lucy, is a ranged dealer with a heavier emphasis on LMB skills.
[*] Theo can be acquired as a login reward until the store system is introduced.
[/list]

[h2]New Map Qua'roa Seabed Factory Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/be86900b132c480c0c6a6e023718fee0c3b6bc20.png[/img]
[h2]Scoreboard and MVP Selection Improved[/h2]

[list]
[*] Mission contribution time added to the scoreboard.
[/list]

[h1]Changeable Skill[/h1]

[h2]Changeable Skill Added[/h2]

Changeable Skill has been added to the following characters:

[list]
[*] Narae
[*] Warmonger
[*] Maximus
[*] Eveleen
[*] Rei
[*] Lucy
[*] Chloe
[*] Alice
[*] Akira
[*] Bernhard
[/list]

[h2]Changeable Skill Button Change[/h2]

[list]
[*] Maximus: Expel Injustice (R2) skill changed to RMB Changeable Skill.
[*] Warmonger: Titan Splash (R2) skill changed to RMB Changeable Skill.
[*] Eveleen: Hadron Wave (E2) skill changed to E1, the original E1 skill removed, and a new E2 skill added.
[/list]

[h1]Key Mapping Feature Added[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/7742a04ac9aca75f72510c1e027892efdfeedb9f.png[/img]
[h1]Balance Adjustment[/h1]

[h2]Supporter Self-Healing Added[/h2]

To allow supporters to survive more easily on their own, self-healing abilities have been added to some skills. (No adjustments were made to Sabio, as his survival ability when alone was deemed sufficient.)

[list]
[*] Narae - Wings of Ascension (R): Heals 120 HP for self.
[*] Chloe - Let's Play, Friend! (Shift2): Heals 60 HP for self.
[*] Chloe - Boing Boing, Horo Ball! (R2): Heals 60 HP for self.
[/list]

[h2]Skill Healing Reduced[/h2]

To prevent excessively long TTK (Time To Kill) with supporters surviving more easily, overall healing skills have been nerfed.

Additionally, to address the situation where Narae quickly revives critically injured allies, RMB skills have been changed to tick-based healing.

[list]
[*] Narae Divine Energy (LMB1): 100 → 80
[*] Narae Yin and Yang (LMB2): 130 → 120
[*] Narae Divine Energy's Radiance (RMB1): 250 → 240 (per 1.5s)
[*] Narae Divine Energy's Wave (RMB2): 150 → 200 (per 3s)
[*] Chloe and Friend (RMB): 75 → 60
[*] Chloe Hey Buddy! Let's Play! (Shift2): 100 → 80
[*] Chloe Boing Boing, Horo Ball! (R2): 125 → 80
[*] Sabio Guardian Automata of Kukulkan (RMB): 50 + 300 (per 3s) → 50 + 200 (per 3s)
[*] Sabio Rescue Grenade (E1) ongoing heal: 75ps → 80ps
[*] Sabio Rescue Grenade (E1) explosion heal: 150 → 120
[*] Bernhard Bloodthirst (E) on use heal: 250 → 200
[*] Bernhard Bloodthirst (E) during activation Lifesteal: 50% → 40%
[*] Bernhard Eternal Hellblade (Q) during activation Lifesteal: 50% → 40%
[*] Akira all skill hit heal: 50 → 40
[/list]

[h2]Max Health Increase[/h2]

With the overall reduction in healing, all characters' HP has been increased to prevent too short a TTK.

[list]
[*] Maximus 1000 → 1150
[*] Warmonger 1100 → 1250
[*] Eveleen 900 → 1050
[*] Volf 900 → 1050
[*] Bernhard 850 → 975
[*] Akira 850 → 950
[*] Alice 750 → 850
[*] Raki 750 → 850
[*] Al Manat 750 → 850
[*] Rei 650 → 750
[*] Lucy 650 → 750
[*] Chloe 650 → 750
[*] Narae 700 → 750
[*] Sabio 650 → 750
[/list]

[h2]Skill Balance Adjustment[/h2]

[list]
[*] Volf Daring Dash (Shift1) cooldown increased: 6s → 7s
[*] Volf Invulnerable Charge (Shift2) cooldown reduced: 6s → 4s
[*] Eveleen Accretion Disc (Shift1), Exotic Matter (Shift2) cooldown reduced: 8s → 6s
[*] Bernhard Rampaging Fury (R2) on hit rage gain: 75 → 80
[*] Bernhard Destruction Dash (Shift1) slam on hit rage: 75 → 100
[*] Bernhard Destruction Dash (Shift1) cooldown reduced: 8s → 7s
[*] Bernhard Savage Dash (Shift2) cooldown reduced: 8s → 7s
[*] Raki Rush (Shift2) combo window increased: 1s → 3s
[*] Raki Rush (Shift2) attack detection improved
[*] Chloe Balloon Horo! (E1) damage increased: 50 → 150
[*] Chloe SO MUCH FUUUUN! (Q) duration increased: 4.5s → 6s
[*] Lucy Scarlet Execution (Q) projectile firing interval increased: 0.1ps → 0.15ps
[*] Rei Frost Explosion (RMB2) no charging removes Slow effect
[*] Sabio Golden Spear of Kukulkan (LMB) damage reduced: 50 → 40
[*] Sabio Golden Spear of Kukulkan (LMB) drone additional damage increased: 30 → 40
[/list]

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Detailed view added to battle records.
[*] Immediate response to jumps and more sustained momentum in the air.
[*] Increased basic movement acceleration.
[*] Improved visibility of successful attack effects.
[*] Support characters now get a warning UI if there are low-health allies.
[*] Stairs added for quick access to the high ground at Peril Rose Backstreets B.
[*] Cargo and Warmonger totems now block attacks like walls.
[*] Warmonger Choke Slam (R) skill now damages and stuns nearby enemies on wall impact.
[*] Warmonger Choke Slam (R) skill allows throwing grabbed enemies into other characters for wall impact effects.
[*] Warmonger Totem Buster (E1) skill now allows movement during use.
[*] Warmonger Totem Buster (E1) skill's totem changed to a rectangular collider for more wall-like behavior.
[*] Warmonger Royal Rumble! (Q) ultimate wall color changed for better visibility.
[*] Al Manat Talon of the Desert (E2) skill now casts instantly at the targeted location.
[*] Raki Furry Flurry (RMB) skill's attack detection height increased.
[*] Maximus Ultimatum of the Hero Assembly (Q) detection height increased.
[*] Stealth UI for Al Manat now only visible to the player.
[*] Bernhard Frenzied Dance (LMB) 1.31 balance hotfix reflected in skill tooltip.
[*] Notification added when a friend request is accepted.
[*] Camera now focuses on the character when zooming in with the mouse wheel.
[*] HUD UI disappears when zooming in on the character with the mouse wheel.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects of grabs or stuns would not disappear.
[/list]

[h1]Additional Changes[/h1]
Following the initial announcement, additional adjustments have been made as follows.
These changes are aimed at balancing and enhancing characters, as discussed in the developer AMA broadcast.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by not providing all the information initially.

[list]
[*] Increase in movement speed for all characters except Maximus: 700 → 785
[*] Increase in base movement speed for Maximus: 750 → 825
[*] Increased movement speed for Raki Meow Meow Zoomies (E1): 100% → 115%
[*] Increased flat movement distance for Raki Purrfect Pounce (E2): 500 → 1100
[*] Addition of a feature for Lucy Phantom Phase (Shift) skill to return to the original point of use after reactivation (rollback)
[/list]

[h3]January 11th Additional Notice[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased time until an occupied Point turns neutral: 5s → 15s
[*] Modified so that the full screen shortcut key (Alt+Enter) does not work
[*] Fixed an issue where animations are displayed abnormally when stunned in the air
[*] Fixed an issue in the training area where the UI for the duration of the original skill remains when changing characters
[*] Fixed an issue where a character caught by Warmonger's grabbing skill passes through the floor
[*] Fog Graphics Modification in Peril Rose Backstreets
[/list]

notes.title: Notice of the Storm Battle System & Implementation
notes.content:
Hello, this is the marketing team of Storm Striker.

In an effort to foster a gaming culture where we can all enjoy together, we have implemented the Storm Battle System. This decision was made after monitoring most of your broadcasts and gaining a clear understanding from both users and streamers. At StormStriker, we believe "It's more fun when we play together."
The Storm Battle System is a collaborative effort with users and streamers who truly enjoy SS. We believe it holds substantial value, even if it takes time to develop. We plan to continuously improve and evolve this system in sync with all of you, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do.

Thank you.

[b]<<Implementation of the Storm Battle System>>[/b]

#What is the Storm Battle System?
A system where a single streamer can form two or more teams, receive support, and organize battles.

#StormStreamer Benefits
Benefit 1. 'Storm Streamer' gets the right to host battles
Benefit 2. Streamers earn points based on participant numbers during a hosted battle [Number of Participants x 50] e.g., [10 people x 50 = Total 500 points]
*Early Bird Benefit: The first 10 applicants for the battle receive [Number of Participants x 100] points
Benefit 3. Points totaling 5000 or more can be monetized (Twitch = 25,000 Bits / AfreecaTV = 5000 Star Balloons)
Benefit 4. Upon achieving 5000 points, upgrade to Super StormStreamer: In-game creation of a unique character profile, increased cash unit, and various additional benefits

#Benefits for Battle Participants
Active participants in the streamer battles will be rewarded with icons and other incentives (details to be announced later).

#Application Q&A
- How to Apply: Fill out the Google form and send a DM to SS_HAN
- English: https://forms.gle/FSi3fJfXPn7r4FTj7
- Streamers can participate in other streamers' battles (broadcasting is mandatory)
- Users & Streamers can rejoin the same streamer's battles, but will not be counted for point allocation

#Basic Format for Battles
- Storm Warrior Slots: Every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 8pm / First come, first served
- Best of 5 (BO5) is recommended (you can propose your own rules after consultation)
- All participants must participate with voice & streamers must broadcast ON

#Procedure
1. Submit a storm battle application to the management staff
2. After approval, monitoring is checked with the broadcast link shared on the disc during the broadcast.
3. Upon completion of the battle, you will be rewarded if you share participants information with the management team.

#Compliance
- Streamers who use profanity or derogatory language during the battle, or act in a way that tarnishes their dignity, may have their qualifications permanently revoked.
- Participants who intentionally act in a way that harms the development of the battle culture may also have their participation rights permanently revoked.
- We plan to continuously revise and improve the implementation plan in a constructive direction (retroactive application of existing plans).
- Once the battle culture is established, we plan to introduce a StormStreamer Championship system as well.

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
[h1]Intro[/h1]

[i]
Hi everyone at Storm Striker! This is Alphakaman, the head of the Design team!

We're having a blast these days, busy preparing for the patch!

After the launch, we noticed quite a few areas that needed improvement. This patch is all about addressing those issues as quickly as we can, focusing on what we can implement right away!

I'll break down the details of the patch for you, item by item!

[/i]

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]

[h2]Ladder Point (LP) System[/h2]

[i]
Ladder Points will be a way for you guys to measure your skills numerically until Rank Matches are introduced! But since it's not a Rank Match yet, we've made it so it's not visible to others, so you don't need to feel too pressured about it.

[/i]

[list]
[*] You can check your LP in your profile and match result screens.
[*] If you leave the game before it starts (known as "deserting"), your LP will significantly decrease.
[*] If you leave the game after it has started (known as "dodging"), your LP will slightly decrease.
[*] The introduction of this system will result in the reset of your MMR (Match Making Rating).
[/list]

[h2]Chat System[/h2]

[i]
We know the in-game chat system has been lacking, making communication with other players challenging. This patch focuses on improving basic chats, especially with friends.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Chatting is now possible on the game result screen.
[*] Party chat in the lobby has been added.
[*] Whisper chat with friends has been added.
[*] Chatting in custom game lobbies is now available.
[/list]

[h2]Early Access Pass Expansion[/h2]

[i]
To enrich your in-game rewards before the regular season pass and store are added, we've expanded the Early Access Pass.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Early Access Pass now extends from a maximum of 15 tiers to 65 tiers.
[/list]

[h2]HUD Changes[/h2]

[i]
We've made the HUD cleaner and adjusted the camera position for more thrilling gameplay.

[/i]

[list]
[*] The design of the HUD has been changed.
[/list]

[h2]Camera Position Adjustment[/h2]

[list]
[*] The distance between the character and camera has been slightly reduced.
[*] The camera has been slightly moved to the right of the character.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/e414ebb11108b5b4c6981b07942fb137f3b5dbbd.png[/img]
The current game screen in development

[h2]Game Timing Adjustments[/h2]

[i]
To provide more breathing room in the game, as battles were deemed too continuous, we've adjusted respawn and point increase times.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Respawn time increased: 12s → 14s
[*] Point increase speed in control games decreased: 1ps → 0.9ps
[*] Point increase speed in conquest games decreased: 0.5ps → 0.45ps
[/list]

[h2]Self-Healing Increase[/h2]

[i]
In Storm Striker, characters start healing themselves 3 seconds after taking damage. To facilitate smoother gameplay for characters other than healers, we've increased the self-healing rate for non-healer characters.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Narae, Chloe, Sabio's HP recovery per second increased: 75ps → 80ps
[*] All characters except Narae, Chloe, Sabio: HP recovery per second increased : 40ps → 60ps
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[i]
After identifying optimization issues post-launch, we've improved areas negatively impacting optimization, removed unused features, and lightly tuned VFX. We'll continue to focus on optimization in future patches, even if not explicitly mentioned.

[/i]

[h2]Training Ground Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added character change feature
[*] Added damage meter feature
[*] Bot characters can now be the same as the player's character
[/list]

[h2]Hitbox Height Adjustment[/h2]

[i]
We've adjusted the hitbox heights of some skills, which were too high compared to their visual representation. For Akira, we've slightly increased the size of the hitbox, which was too low even to avoid by jumping.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Volf's Righteous Strike (R) top hitbox adjusted from 400 to 300, bottom from 0 to 150
[*] Bernhard's Inferno Strike (R1) top hitbox adjusted from 600 to 300, bottom from 600 to 150
[*] Alice's Gale Strike (R) charging top hitbox from 500 to 400, bottom from 100 to 150
[*] Akira's Battōjutsu (R) basic top hitbox from 100 to 150, bottom from 100 to 150
[*] Akira's Battōjutsu (R) Empowered top hitbox from 100 to 150, bottom from 100 to 150
[/list]

[h2]Sabio Adjustments[/h2]

[i]
Initially, Sabio was designed as a character with hit-scan attacks, leaning more towards a damage dealer. However, upon observing players' gameplay, we noticed a significant disparity between the low and high points of hit-scan. Realizing the game lacked enough healers and that leaving Sabio as a damage-focused healer was problematic, we've adjusted Sabio to be more of a hybrid between a healer and a dealer. The high points as a dealer are lowered, and the low points are raised, transferring some of the dealer capabilities to enhance the healer role.

[/i]

[h3]Golden Spear of Kukulkan(LMB)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Attack range increased: 50 → 125
[*] With the increased attack range, the Rei effect may appear curved from the reticle.
[*] Base damage reduced: : 70 → 50
[*] Empowered damage while using Nitro Gliding (Shift) reduced : 120 → 70
[*] Range for triggering additional hits from drones on impact reduced : 30m → 20m
[/list]

[h3]Guardian Automata of Kukulkan(RMB)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Healing amount increased : 250 → 300
[*] Duration increased : 2s → 3s
[*] Cooldown reduced : 4s → 3s
[/list]

[h3]Rescue Grenade(E1)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Continuous healing reduced : 100ps → 75ps
[*] Healing effect on Sabio reduced to half
[/list]

[h3]Reaction Grenade(E2)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Damage increased : 50 → 100
[*] Swapped the buttons for E2 (Rescue Grenade) and E1 (Reaction Grenade)
[/list]

[h2]Al Manat Adjustments[/h2]

[i]
Al Manat's reliance on the LMB → E → LMB combo was considered too strong, so we've adjusted it to reduce its dominance. While the combo can be enjoyable, the skill gap between those who know it and those who don't was too significant. Additionally, Al Manat's evasive capabilities made it too challenging for opponents to track her. We've slightly reduced the effectiveness of her Shift skill to make her position easier to anticipate.

[/i]

[h3]Throwing Daggers(LMB)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Damage reduced: 110 → 90
[*] Fire rate reduced: 0.75 → 0.5
[/list]

[h3]Arid Blade(E1)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Damage increased: 50 → 75
[*] Cooldown increased: 1.5 → 3
[/list]

[h3]Talon of the Desert(E2)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Damage increased: 50 → 75
[/list]

[h3]Spirit of the Dune(Shift)[/h3]

[list]
[*] Movement speed starts at 150% and gradually slows down
[*] Cancels on being stunned
[/list]

[h2]Volf[/h2]

[i]
Volf, a tank character boasting high win rates lately, has been adjusted. While maintaining his appeal as a mobile and powerful tank, we've reduced his health to balance his strength.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Maximum health reduced: 1000 → 900
[/list]

[h2]Eveleen[/h2]

[i]
Eveleen players felt too much pressure using the R skill, so we've modified it to grant a significant shield when used. However, to prevent her from becoming too powerful, we've also reduced her health.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Using Tachyon Field (R) now grants a 200 shield lasting for 2 seconds
[*] Maximum health reduced: 1000 → 900
[/list]

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]

[i]
The following changes mainly focus on improving convenience and gameplay experience.

notes.title: Update plans after Early Access release
notes.content:
[h1]Intro[/h1]
Hello, Storm Striker users, this is Alphakaman, the head of the Design Team.

It's already been two weeks since the release of Storm Striker.

Since the last hotfix, our development team has been fully focused on preparing the next patch.

I have revised our pre-launch plans to address the issues of Storm Striker as quickly as possible and to evolve the game into a better experience for you all. Today, I'll share those plans with you.

[h1]Update Plan[/h1]
First off, here's our major update plan up until next February. It's not long-term, but I believe it's a plan that will solve the current major issues and expand the fun that the game offers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/d6ac3a2299213fece109f61df847656d859c11b0.png[/img]

[h1]Patch#1[/h1]
This is the upcoming patch that I mentioned on Discord, originally scheduled for December 7th. However, as it includes more content than initially planned, unfortunately, the patch has been rescheduled to December 11th.

I ask for your understanding regarding this change in schedule.

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
The development team was aware that the optimization was significantly lacking, and for this patch, we applied tasks that could be quickly implemented.

The development team recognizes the importance of optimization and will continue to work on improving it.

[h2]Expanded AE PASS[/h2]
I thought now wasn't the right time to introduce monetization elements into the game, and since the addition of a season pass system is not in the immediate plans of my new update strategy, I felt that players needed some form of reward until then.

For that reason, we've dramatically expanded the Early Access Battle Pass by including items that were intended for future sale.

Below are the portraits of skins that you can additionally acquire in this expansion. (Please note that the actual color of the skins may differ from their portraits.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/9d3155e1252009b956160d881a031785ee300e09.png[/img]

[h2]Ladder Point System[/h2]
The AE Pass expansion is a system for more casual players, while the LP system is designed for the more hardcore gamers. It's not exact, but we're adding LP that somewhat reflects MMR, allowing players to quantify their skills.

However, since it's not an official ranked game, we don't want players to feel pressured, so you'll only be able to see your own LP.

We ask for your understanding as the MMR will be reset in the December 11th patch to accommodate the addition of this system.

[h2]Chat System[/h2]
We're aware that the in-game chat is currently quite limited, and it's one of the reasons the patch scheduled for the 7th has been pushed back to the 11th.

After the patch, you'll be able to chat in the lobby with your party and privately with friends through whispers.

While this isn't a complete implementation of chat, it's a significant improvement over what was available before.

[h2]Language Support[/h2]
We hope that by supporting more languages, players from a variety of cultures can enjoy the game more comfortably. In addition to English and Korean, the list of languages we plan to support are as follows:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[/list]

[h1]Patch#2[/h1]
[h2]AI Opponent[/h2]
We've noticed that many new players of Storm Striker are struggling to adapt to the game, leading to them dropping out.

Adding AI opponents is a feature intended to help these players ease into the game. Newcomers will initially play several games against AI characters, allowing them to acclimate to the game before playing with other users.

[h2]New Hero : Theo[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/636c283344bd42e2f18b96ca3492bdb264d0f862.jpg[/img]
Theo is a ranged character with simple and intuitive controls, fitting for a shooter game. We anticipate that Theo will offer a distinct and enjoyable experience compared to other ranged characters.

[h2]Skill Change Extension (Primary)[/h2]
One of the most positive and unexpected responses since the launch was to the swap skill system. Players found it more intriguing than I had anticipated, and I see great potential in it.

Naturally, it makes sense to further specialize and expand on a system that players enjoy.

Since you can't change characters mid-game in Storm Striker, we want each character to have more potential. This work, along with the trait system, should well integrate this intent into the game.

In Patch#2, as a start, we plan to overhaul underused swap skills and add a third swap skill to some characters.

For instance, Narae's E skill could change to a buff that increases allies' movement speed, and Maximus's E skill might become one that sets up a barrier upfront, making it easier to break through heavily contested corridors.

[h2]Key Binding[/h2]
This is the Key Binding feature that many of you have inquired about.
As it is indeed a necessary feature, we are aiming to add it as soon as possible.

[h1]Patch#3[/h1]
[h2]Talents System[/h2]
The Talents system is designed to allow character building during gameplay in combination with swap skills. (However, it won't be in a way that creates a disparity in progress with the opponent.)

As I mentioned earlier in the **Skill Change Extension (Primary)**, it's an additional system intended to deepen the aspects of the game that players find interesting.

I will organize and share more detailed information about this system sometime next week.

[h2]New Hero : Electra[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/153bbcc4fbbc7750ae9b7d842a1ad2b27cfa9781.jpg[/img]
Electra is a healer with an explosive combination of healing and damage potential, featuring a resource system reminiscent of Bernhard's rage.

Initially designed to be a sub-healer similar to a damage dealer like Sabio, Electra has been modified to also serve as a main healer like Narae, depending on the swap skills used. This flexibility will be reflected in the upcoming release.

[h2]Shop & BattlePass[/h2]
BM (Business Model) is essential for the survival of the development company and also a way for us to provide various content to our players. There's not much to elaborate on this. We're eager to offer a wider range of skins to our users soon.

[h1]Patch#4[/h1]
[h2]Skill Change Extension (Secondary)[/h2]
Following the Skill Change Extension (Primary), the Skill Change Extension (Secondary) will involve a re-evaluation of swap skills, and we plan to add a third swap skill to all characters. This patch, along with these adjustments, is likely to also address the many changes brought about by the Talents System.

[h2]New Hero : Shifu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/0fdd7dfda6da8a6023c4d4d120b72437955e49b4.jpg[/img]
Siphu is a fast and versatile melee healer who can deal damage to enemies while also healing nearby allies.

Depending on the swap skills chosen, Siphu can be specialized either to dominate enemies alongside tanks or bruisers, or to protect allied ranged characters from the backline.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Like the Key Binding feature, there have been many inquiries about pad support. We hope that this change will allow more people to enjoy the game more comfortably.

[h1]Outro[/h1]
By the next patch on the 11th, the development team plans to cover the Talents System and detailed contents of the patch on the 11th, as well as hold an AMA session.

We ask for your continued interest and support. The development team will do our best to provide you with a better game.

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice for the November 23rd Update
notes.content:
Greetings, this is GM KM from Storm Striker.

I would like to provide an advance notice regarding the scheduled update for November 23rd.

The update on November 23rd will prioritize adjustments to the Assassin and Tank characters.

- All Characters
  * Our first priority is to distribute damage output more evenly.
  * There will be enhancements for Tank and Bruiser types, along with downward adjustments for Assassins and Ranged characters.

- Assassins:
  * Currently, it's possible for Assassins to defeat opposing characters in a single combo; our goal is to add additional steps to this process.
  * We aim to reduce burst damage while maintaining overall DPS.
  * We want to mitigate conditions that allow Assassin characters to eliminate enemy players without risk. However, we'll ensure that the value of Assassins does not become too diminished during this process.

- Tanks:
  * The development team acknowledges that there are often situations where Tank characters do not have a significant impact on the game.
  * For Maximus and Warmonger, we plan adjustments such as increasing movement speed so they can more effectively influence team play.

We will provide detailed information through an additional announcement later on. 

Thank you.

 -Balance adjustment details

The development team recently became convinced that the battles in Storm Striker are chaotic and a lot happens in a short amount of time.

Although there have been similar evaluations in the past, watching North American users play during the Steam Fest greatly influenced our recent decision.

We plan to make adjustments to slow down the battles a bit, but we won't risk making too aggressive changes that might lose the original fun of the game.

After making some conservative overall adjustments this time, we will keep a close eye to ensure the battle pace is appropriate on an ongoing basis.

Adjustments to slow down the battles will be made in two main ways.

Firstly, we will increase health.
We noticed that once assassins, ranged dealers, and supporters start getting attacked in battle, the time until they die is very short, making it hard to perceive and make decisions during combat. While experienced users can utilize these characters’ skills to survive even in extreme situations, we thought this might be harsh for inexperienced users. Therefore, we plan to increase the maximum HP.

However, we think that the current healer characters have excellent survivability. So, we've increased the max HP to enhance survival for beginner users and made some adjustments to the skill performance to weaken the potential of experienced users.

Secondly, we will reduce movement.
We thought that a few skills currently move too fast to track with the eye, causing fatigue due to the constant need to keep track of the enemy’s position.

We've reduced the speed of such skills and, accordingly, also reduced the range of some ranged skills.
Also, we’ve made characters move a bit slower left, right, and backward to suppress overall character movement during battles.

notes.title: Storm Striker CBT Event!
notes.content:
※ This event is only for Koreans.

Hello! This is Storm Striker GM MH.
To commemorate Storm Striker's monumental CBT, we have prepared a commemorative event!

Please check below for more details!

1. If you match more than once, everyone will receive a gift!
  - If you play a match even once during the CBT period, you will receive in-game cash that can be used after the official launch!
  ※ Game cash coupons will be paid after official service.

2. Gifts will be awarded through a drawing to those who access the game for more than 3 days and play matches!
  - If you access the game for more than 3 days during the CBT period and match at least once a day, you will receive a prize through a drawing!
* Baedal Minjok gift certificate 10,000 won * 20 people
* Gen.G x Storm Striker collaboration t-shirt * 30 people

3. If you match more than 10 times, you will receive a gift through a drawing!
  - If you match more than 10 times during the CBT period, you will receive a prize through a drawing!
* Baedal Minjok gift certificate 10,000 won * 30 people

4. Gift given when you achieve 30 wins!
  - Those who achieve 30 wins during the CBT period will receive a gift through a drawing!
    * Cherry tenkeyless blue keyboard * 3 people

5. Gift given when ranking is achieved!
  - Celebrating the addition of the ranking system! You will receive a gift based on the ranking you achieved during the CBT period!
* 1st place: Galaxy Watch 6 * 1 person
* 2nd to 3rd place: Baedal Minjok gift certificate 50,000 won * 2 people

6. Receive a gift when you achieve 10 wins per day!
  - Automatic entry into the event when you achieve 10 wins per day
  - The more you accumulate 10 wins per day, the higher your winning probability!
     * Laser Barracuda

7. Receive a gift through a drawing when you participate in the survey!
  - After CBT ends, prizes will be awarded through a drawing among those who participated in the survey!
* Baedal Minjok gift certificate 5,000 won * 30 people

※ Events 2 and 3 cannot be won multiple times.


In addition to this, various other events may be held(?)
Please always check the notices!

We hope you have a great Storm Striker CBT!
